keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to find Skool communities. Each keyword runs a separate DuckDuckGo search. Example: ["cold email", "online course", "agency growth"]

limit.title: Max results
limit.description: Maximum number of communities to return. Lower values cost less. Each result is charged separately.

minMembers.title: Minimum member count
minMembers.description: Skip communities with fewer members than this. Set to 0 to return all communities regardless of size.

requestTimeout.title: Request timeout
requestTimeout.description: Seconds to wait for each page to load. Increase if you see timeout errors.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Skool uses AWS WAF which blocks datacenter IPs. Residential proxies are required for reliable results.
